_rules: r2.dev public access stays DISABLED on every bucket (including public-media: use the custom domain).
Private buckets have no public domain at all.
Staging and production never share a bucket or an API token.

buckets.name: gobye-staging-public-media
buckets.purpose: Approved public images and clips, served via media.gobye.app (custom domain, not r2.dev).

buckets.name: gobye-staging-private-documents
buckets.purpose: Driver licences, identity documents, vehicle papers, profile photos. Never public.

buckets.name: gobye-staging-private-evidence
buckets.purpose: Incident photos and videos. Never public. Legal-hold capable.

buckets.name: gobye-staging-private-uploads
buckets.purpose: Quarantine: every upload lands here first until verified and scanned. Never public.
